preconditions.description: The number of provinces P must be between 1 and 15.
The number of columns N in each province must be between 1 and 600.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for S in [S1, S2])
preconditions.description: Each row string S1 and S2 must have a length equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S1 + S2)
preconditions.description: All characters in the row strings S1 and S2 must be lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct strings formed by the knight's path in each province.
